findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_datasets, scrape_url, free_prices, prices, stock_price, ecom_product, ecom_catalog, scrape_text · Private data: list_datasets, free_feeds, free_defi_top_yields, staking_yields, free_tokenized_stocks, free_prices, prices, address_poisoning, binance_flows_report, free_tokenized_real_estate, tokenized_real_estate, hack_tracker, free_traders, trader_wallet, meme_new_pools, meme_history, lookup_yields, lookup_token_risk, whale_netflow, whale_token, token_verdict, wallet_profile, dd_report, dd_quick, trust_agent, counterparty_check, token_holders · Public sink: alerts_subscribe_week, ecom_snapshot, counterparty_check, token_holders · Destructive: get_dataset.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_datasets, scrape_url, free_prices, prices, stock_price, ecom_product, ecom_catalog, scrape_text · Private data: list_datasets, free_feeds, free_defi_top_yields, staking_yields, free_tokenized_stocks, free_prices, prices, address_poisoning, binance_flows_report, free_tokenized_real_estate, tokenized_real_estate, hack_tracker, free_traders, trader_wallet, meme_new_pools, meme_history, lookup_yields, lookup_token_risk, whale_netflow, whale_token, token_verdict, wallet_profile, dd_report, dd_quick, trust_agent, counterparty_check, token_holders · Public sink: alerts_subscribe_week, ecom_snapshot, counterparty_check, token_holders · Destructive: get_dataset

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
